thread:

```
may our plants outlast deploys
and our coffee remain lukewarm but hopeful
```

opsbot: reaction summary — :kelp: 6, :no_entry_sign: 1

sophia: deep tide for contrast.
dennis: seafoam for the insta pics.
lena: seafoam wins. i'll order keycaps and coordinate shipping to the office + remote folks.

opsbot: reminder set for 3pm planning in #random (thread pinned).
mira: thanks all — kelpie forever. :seaweed:
